context: New Year's morning. The Saito family living room (mom Yumiko, dad Ryosuke, daughter Hina) plus grandma Sachiko visiting from out of town. The osechi is out; everyone has been awake too long.
purpose: four-speaker family New Year — overlapping affection across generations

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: みなさん、明けまして、おめでとう。
lines.style: Slow, ceremonial entrance. Warm acknowledgment of the moment. Clear on each word, letting the greeting breathe. A grandmother's way of beginning.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: おめでとうございます、お母さん。
lines.style: Gentle formality, half-bow in the voice. Respectful return without stiffness. The rhythm of tradition, held lightly.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 明けましておめでとうございます。本当に、来てくれて、ありがとう。
lines.en: Happy new year. Truly — thank you for coming.
lines.style: Steady, unhurried welcome. Weight on 'truly.' Not effusive, but the gratitude is unguarded. Host's attentiveness without performance.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: おばあちゃん、おめでとう！お年玉は？
lines.en: Grandma — happy new year! Where's my otoshidama?
lines.style: Bright, direct eight-year-old energy. The whole holiday compressed into one breathless question. No filter between thought and voice.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: (laughs) はいはい、ちゃんとあるよ、ひなちゃん。
lines.en: (laughs) Yes, yes — I've got it, Hina-chan.
lines.style: A genuine, indulgent laugh. Already moving to find the envelope. Warm conspiracy with a child. The laugh lands before the words.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: A gentle correction with half-laughter underneath. Not stern — the voice carries both the moment and permission to move past it quickly.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: はーい。…おばあちゃん、今年もよろしく。
lines.en: Okaaay. …Grandma — let's have a good year.
lines.style: Obedience with a small sigh. Voice softens into formality. The adjustment is visible in the voice's posture.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: こちらこそ、ひなちゃん。…本当に、大きくなったね。
lines.style: A classic grandmother line that catches her own voice. Slight tremor on 'really.' Looking at the child, not past her. Time-awareness in the observation.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: お母さん、お雑煮、いかがですか？
lines.style: Hospitable ease. The question is an offer woven into care. Unhurried, present — the dad settling into his role.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: いただきます。本当に、家族で食べるご飯は、いちばん。
lines.en: Itadakimasu. Truly — eating with family is the best.
lines.style: A beat of pause before speaking. Voice slightly quieter, more reflective. The simplicity of the observation grounds it. Genuine without sentimentality.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Pure eight-year-old declaration. Voice bounces on the number. No self-editing, no hesitation. The joy is unguarded and physical in the delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 一個ずつ、お母さん。お餅は、本当に詰まるから。
lines.en: One at a time, Mom. Mochi really gets stuck.
lines.style: Practical warning wrapped in affection. Not alarming — matter-of-fact concern. A parent's observation delivered with genuine care underneath.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: お母さんもね、ゆっくり。今日は、時間ある。
lines.en: Mom too — slowly. We've got time today.
lines.style: Inclusive and unhurried. A soft glance woven into the words. Not lecturing — offering permission. The generosity is in the pace.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 本当に、ね。…一緒に過ごせて、嬉しい。
lines.en: Truly. …I'm glad we can spend time together.
lines.style: A moment of unguarded softness. Voice drops slightly. The pause before 'I'm glad' is the whole feeling. Quieter than before — vulnerability in simplicity.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 今年、たくさん遊ぼうね、おばあちゃん。
lines.en: Let's play lots this year, Grandma.
lines.style: A kid-promise delivered with bright sincerity. No irony, no performance — the offer is real. Voice lands heavier than her usual energy because she means it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: …ありがとう、ひなちゃん。本当に。
lines.style: A real catch in the voice. The pause before speaking is the whole weight. 'Really' is unsteady but honest. The morning condenses into this one moment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 来年も、再来年も、一緒に。家族で、いっぱい時間作ろう。
lines.en: Next year — the year after too. Together. As a family, lots of time.
lines.style: A closing-but-opening line. Steady, attentive presence underneath. Not rushing. Each phrase lands with intention. The voice carries a quiet promise.
